All actual source/reference/manual/refinement/secondary/patch/extraction histories are linked; this assembly required no new ImageGen call. Static held display only; real near/far state and weapon ready/resting behavior remain required integrated work after full generation.
palette_and_scale: Reviewed neutral and captured Qud palettes in all four facings and 48x96 frame previews with nearest enlarged companions. Neutral components remain grayscale. Body/head use actual tileColor w, separate dulla/head-detail uses W, and Cloth Robe and Shillelagh each use their own captured y/y palette. Shared512x1024 canvas, contact256,950 and each row's unchanged world mapping preserve the larger dromad scale; the staff is not normalized or resized to the body. Hidden authoring previews are empty. These are art inspections, not native visibility, equipment, motion, hurt, look or save/load acceptance; no native activation or game/harness test was performed.
